text:
nora: Drafted a short release note entry for embeddings streaming deprecation. Key callouts: timeline (deprecated now, removed in 2 releases), migration path (switch to batched embedding endpoints), and an example conversion. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4240

devin: Where should we put the SDK migration snippet? Top of the embeddings page or a separate migration guide? I vote separate guide with copyable snippets for all SDKs.

nora: Separate guide seems cleaner. I'll add a `migrations/embeddings-streaming.md` and link from the embeddings reference. Also adding a short blurb in relnotes.

charlie: I'll add the Node + Python conversion examples. Proposed Node example to replace streaming producer:
```js
// old streaming call
for await (const chunk of client.embeddings.stream({ model: 'squid' })) {
  // process
}
// new batched call
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'squid', input: ['prompt1', 'prompt2'] });
console.log(resp.data[0].embedding);
```

yuki: Heads up: the JS SDK recently renamed `embeddings.create` -> `embeddings.embed` in the alpha client. We should show both and note which client version each snippet targets.

nora: Good catch. I'll add a short note: "Use `embeddings.embed` for @alpha clients; `embeddings.create` for stable."

docs-bot: link-checker: found one internal anchor to `/reference/embeddings#streaming` which will be removed. Suggest replace with `/reference/embeddings#migration`. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/linkcheck/4240

devin: I'll push the migration guide and include a small troubleshooting section: when batched inputs mismatch ordering, use the `id` field to re-associate responses. Small snippet: 
```py
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='squid', input=[{'id': 'a', 'text': '...'}, {'id': 'b', 'text': '...'}])
# match by resp.data[i].id
```

charlie: Also added a known-issue note: some customers relying on single-token streaming latency may see slightly higher end-to-end latency when switching to batched calls; recommend conservative batching size.

nora: OK checklist: [x] relnote blurb, [ ] migration guide file, [x] internal link updates (PR pending), [x] SDK notes drafted. Target merge: tomorrow morning.

docs-bot: deploy preview once PR created.

nora: Thanks all. I'll open the migration guide PR and ping #docs when it's ready.
